title: update-event-builder-field-sets-custom-metadata-types.html
content: Choosing which fields appear on the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} ’s page layout allows you to customize your organization’s user experience. Some of the benefits of editing the Builder’s page layout include: Simplifying the {{variable.Object_Event}} creation process. It becomes clearer to Event Organizers which information is required. Reducing the time spent switching between {{variable.Object_Event}} records and the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} . Ensuring only relevant fields are visible, which increases the efficiency of creating or editing an {{variable.Object_Event}} . Control conference360__Title__c Waitlist Capacity conference360__Waitlist_Capacity__c Waitlist Enabled conference360__Waitlist_Enabled__c Update a Field Set There are two ways to update a field set. One is from the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} , and the other is in the Object Manager. Event Builder Open the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} . Go to the section you want to update. Click the “click here” link at the bottom of the section.   Click {{variable.Button_SF_Edit}} .   Drag and drop the field in the “In the Field Set” box.   Click {{variable.Button_Save}} .   Switch back to Lightning. If you have an open {{variable.Object_Event}} in the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} , save the {{variable.Object_Event}} before refreshing the page. Object Manager Go to Setup. Click the Object Manager tab. Search for the {{variable.Object_Event}} , {{variable.Object_EventItem}} , or {{variable.Object_Session}} object. Select the object. Click the Field Sets tab. Select the field set you want to update. Drag and drop the field in the “In the Field Set” box. Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Custom Metadata Types Custom Metadata Types also include the “Event Builder Configuration” metadata type with the following records: Emails, Sessions, FAQs, Speaker, Sponsor, Attendees, and Event Content. Event Organizers can simplify the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} experience by setting the Event Builder Configuration custom metadata types to hide optional sections. The Tickets page cannot be hidden, but the Landing Page is visible by default and cannot be hidden. If the {{variable.Field_SF_Visible}} field is checked, the corresponding page will be visible in the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}} ; otherwise, it will be hidden. Change Custom Metadata Types Follow the steps below to change the “Event Builder Configuration” metadata types. Go to Setup. In the Quick Find box, enter and click “Custom Metadata Types.” Click Manage Records next to Event Builder Configuration. Click {{variable.Button_SF_Edit}} next to the section you want to show or hide. Check {{variable.Field_SF_Visible}} . Click {{variable.Button_Save}} .
